title: Intracellular cholesterol visualization in brain tissue using D4H∗
protocol: Rinse sections 3 × 5 min with wash buffer.
Remove wash buffer and add blocking/permeabilization buffer containing 0.02% saponin.
Incubate sections in blocking/permeabilization buffer at 37°C for 90 min.
Rinse sections 2 × 5 min with wash buffer.
Incubate with D4H∗-mCherry recombinant protein working solution for 2 h.
Rinse sections 2 × 5 min with wash buffer.
Rinse sections 1 × 5 min with PBS.
Incubate the sections with 4% PFA for 20 min.
Remove the 4% PFA solution and rinse 2 × 5 min with PBS.
Remove the PBS and rinse 1 × 5 min with wash buffer.
Re-block the sections with blocking/permeabilization buffer for 60 min at RT.
Rinse sections 2 × 5 min with wash buffer.
Incubate with rabbit anti-Rab5 antibody at 1:1000 in antibody diluent overnight at 4°C.
Rinse the sections 3 × 10 min with wash buffer.
Incubate with a biotin-labeled secondary antibody for 90 min.
Rinse 3 × 10 min with wash buffer.
Remove the wash buffer and incubate with Elite ABC-HRP Kit solution for 90 min.
Rinse 2 × 5 min with wash buffer.
Rinse 1 × 5 min with PBS.
Prepare 7.5 μM tyramide-fluorescein from the 1000x stock solution in 0.0015% H2O2 buffer.
Incubate the sections with 7.5 μM tyramide-fluorescein for 10 min at RT.
Rinse 3 × 10 min with wash buffer.
Incubate with rabbit-anti mCherry primary antibody at 1:500 in antibody diluent overnight at 4°C.
Rinse tissues 3 × 10 min with wash buffer.
Incubate tissues with Alexa Fluor 647 anti-Rabbit secondary antibody at 1:1000 in antibody diluent for 90 min.
Rinse tissues 1 × 5 min with wash buffer.
Incubate tissues with 1 μg/mL DAPI solution in PBS for 30 min.
Rinse tissues 3 × 10 min with wash buffer.
Incubate tissues with quench buffer for 30 min.
Rinse tissues 3 × 5 min with 0.02% saponin.
Transfer sections to microscope slides and encircle the sections with a Pap pen to create a hydrophobic barrier.
Ensure that the sections are always covered with PBS.
Remove any excess PBS from the tissues by carefully dabbing the microscope slide with a tissue.
Incubate the tissues with TrueBlack solution for no more than 4 min.
Carefully pour or pipette off the TrueBlack.
Rinse 2x with 70% ethanol for 1 min each.
Rinse with 0.02% saponin solution for 5 min.
Wipe off any excess 0.02% saponin with a tissue so that the microscope slide is dry, but the tissue sections are still moist.
Add 50 μL ProLong Glass Antifade Mountant solution.
Gently place the coverslip on top.
Let the microscope slides dry at RT in the dark for at least 24 h to allow the mountant to cure hard-set.
